packet.documentation: Free movement (osIROSE): a character moving the new way, as its client reported it and the zone accepted it, for the players around (not the mover). Their clients carry it on along heading at speed until the next state, and to the exact place on a stop. Positions in cm; angles 0..65535 for 0..360 degrees.

element.name: flags
element.documentation: As PAKCS_MOVE_STATE's: bit 0 moving, bit 1 walking.

element.name: speed
element.documentation: The zone's speed for the character now, cm a second.
